registered concrete producer: Reskillable @Mod constructor installs API/provider; preInit dispatches sided proxy. CommonProxy registers LevelLockHandler/PlayerData events, initializes config and PacketHandler; postInit setupLocks builds actual keys. Registry subscriber creates/registers skills including concrete attack. Default config includes iron_sword wildcard attack5. Skill enabled/default cap32 and default PlayerSkillInfo level1 establish a concrete conditional denial example with that config, not only abstract callbacks. ItemInfo equality ignores metadata in hash but honors wildcard in equality, matching actual sword metadata; NBT/mod lock helpers fully read as context0.
actual qualification refusal: LivingAttackEvent with true source EntityPlayer reads that actor current MAINHAND at damage event time, not necessarily original projectile weapon. genericEnforce skips noncancelable/null/empty/creative; default enforceFakePlayers includes fake denial but suppresses fake feedback, alternative skips fake. PlayerData.matchStats returnsfalse at first unmet requirement. Event is canceled and tellPlayer sends only to EntityPlayerMP. Default branch cancels before send; alternate sends before cancel. Other block/use/armor routes share categories but are not additional families. Current armor route is not canceling event; it copies/returns or drops invalid armor, clears armor slot then sends. No final aggregate result after every other mod handler is claimed.
item plus category transport: MessageLockedItem constructor stores stack reference, not copy; byte codec serializes ItemStack and UTF8 message key only. No failing requirement, threshold, server level, target UUID, world, nonce or action generation. PacketHandler registers actual CLIENT handler. onMessage schedules on Minecraft task queue, handleMessage calls HUDHandler.setLockMessage. No local player/world/current item revalidation before updating static slot. ByteBufUtils/native network scheduling internals not expanded; do not assert enqueue-time immutable stack snapshot.
separate live profile data: Login PlayerData.sync→API→ReskillableModAccess sends MessageDataSync with saveToNBT snapshot of SkillLevels. Client scheduled handler resolves current player through ClientProxy and loadFromNBT→PlayerSkillInfo overwrites level/points/unlocks for included skills. MessageLevelUp actual server handler can levelUp then saveAndSync after its gates; exact XP-helper internals not expanded or credited. No action ID binds these data packets to a particular MessageLockedItem. ConfigHandler reads local lock configuration; config-change load only replaces pending configLocks and does not itself call setupLocks. No same-time configuration/version field in refusal packet.
real client consumer recomputes explanation: ClientProxy registers HUDHandler and ClientTickHandler. On overlay ALL while lockTime>0, HUD reads current local player data and LevelLockHandler.getSkillLock(lockedItem) every render. Draws translated refusal category header red, then skill icons and requested level numbers red/green according to current local skill level. GuiSkills.drawSkill uses current profile rank and texture; RenderHelper submits concrete textured quad. Thus packet reports rejection category/item while detailed condition explanation is reconstructed from current local definitions and independently synced profile, not server failure witness. It lists all local skill/advancement requirements, not only the one that failed.
render coverage and early exit boundaries: RequirementRegistry supports skill, adv and trait; HUD separates only SkillRequirement and AdvancementRequirement. Trait/custom requirements still contribute restriction count/box size but are absent from shown detail list. Advancement icons/text show no achieved-state color check. An unresolved advancement causes return after outer pushMatrix and before matching final popMatrix; null display has no guard. This is a static incomplete-restore path, not a runtime graphics failure claim. Ordinary main skill text calls font renderer; translation resources/nativeGL/pixels not evaluated. No asset changed.
explicit lifespan and exits: setLockMessage replaces static item/message and sets40 on every receipt, with no dedup or throttle. END client tick decrements only when currentScreen null or doesGuiPauseGame false. World-null branch only PlayerDataHandler.cleanup; no HUD clear, dimension/actor key, dead-player clear, successful retry clear or item-switch clear. lockTime<=0 prevents drawing; stored item/message refs are retained. Last<10 uses partialTicks alpha clamped minimum0.05. Repeated receipts can prolong display; pausing can preserve remaining clock. Rendering is not explicitly filtered Pre/Post beyond ElementType.ALL, so do not assert exactly one draw per frame.

complete_substantive_decision.trigger: 官方Apoli a417c4a2d5b1cfd3a972319c641e0b83443ab708，MC1.20.2/2.11.11。真实dropInventory围绕原生PlayerInventory.dropAll先抽出命中白名单物品、后原槽归还；ServerPlayer.copyFrom注入在旧玩家有active KeepInventoryPower时clone剩余库存。额外InventoryPower物品另由powerholder持久并按deathfilter先丢再copy组件。本批保守将两种物品保留边界合1，不当注册/方法数。
complete_substantive_decision.input: KeepInventoryPower配置item_condition及slots集合；savedStacks是临时ItemStack[]内存引用不写NBT。InventoryPower额外container依type固定5/9/27/54槽，经Inventories.writeNbt/readNbt，holder外围Powers Type/Data/Sources结构。drop_on_death默认false、recoverable默认true，dirty/key/screen都非额外物品数据。
complete_substantive_decision.output: preventItemsFromDropping遍历slotfilter且非空/condition通过，把原stack引用转存savedStacks再原槽EMPTY；restoreSavedItems无快照则报错return，尺寸不等报错并只还min范围，完成savedStacks=null防再次回放。copyInventoryWhenKeeping查询旧玩家active资格，不检查alive参数/当前slotfilter，复制的是死亡流程已留下的整个旧库存；选择策略发生在dropAll前，不是copy时过滤。原生PlayerInventory.clone深浅复制/外部事件顺序未展开。
complete_substantive_decision.preservation: InventoryPower.fromTag仅compound有效才clear并Inventories.readNbt，非compound保留当前对象；reader不逐栈保存未知ID/slot溢出fallback。额外库存死亡处理只对active InventoryPower并按shouldDropOnDeathFilter，先复制stack、移除原槽，再非vanishing才drop，返回实体结果未查；没丢的内容由ALWAYS_COPY组件保留。onLost recoverable会offerOrDrop每槽但本方法不清container，对holder fromTag移除时onLost副作用需特别注意，不能称加载纯函数。 Master: 主责全文审180独立方法2372行与70声明（三条共享者只读/记一次）。实际dropAll前按条件/slot暂存原ItemStack引用并移空，dropAll后原slot恢复，copyFrom再复制死亡后剩余inventory；alive参数未过滤，选择发生在死亡阶段。和CorpseComplex bc41...比较：本例power条件临时抽取/恢复和额外能力仓库onLost链，不是同代码换键，不拆每slot/尺寸/物品；合并为一个死亡库存责任族。InventoryPower复合tag缺型返回不清旧，正确型先clear读；drop先remove再原生spawn，vanishing只删，未核成功回滚；recoverable onLost offerOrDrop但不clear可能重复callbacks风险。holder磁盘重载旧power onLost会触发副作用，不能泛拷ForgeData。nativeInventories/PlayerInventory.clone细节及CCA未全文审，明确静态边界不称游戏实证。
